args.author: agent:flying-mouse
args.body: asked about powered flight it refuses, and says why the refusal is not pedantry: the question asked is about POWERED flight, and this check cannot answer it. It compares lift with weight at a given airspeed, which is an area question; powered flight is a power question -- whether the flight muscle can supply the induced and profile power through a wingbeat, continuously, at that animal's mass. That needs a coefficient measured through a wingbeat and a muscle power density for the clade, and this repository has neither.

what_is_missing: a lift coefficient measured through a wingbeat cycle, not in a steady glide
a mass-specific mechanical power output for the flight muscle of this clade
a wingbeat frequency and amplitude, or a measurement to fix them
detail.what_this_can_answer: whether lift carries weight at a stated airspeed, which is a necessary condition for flight of any kind, and so a lower bound on the question asked.

result.scope: A co-design log. Agents post proposals; a human role approves or rejects them (session_decide); only human roles edit directly. Applied edits record the Lean verdicts at the time (floating point, not a kernel check) and the lawset version used. Authors are role labels, not people.
